title: A New Droid
description: The Resistance escape is now in overdrive. The group reconvenes at ochi's ship and blasts off. The apparent loss of Chewbacca is almost too much for all of them to bear, especially for Rey, who feels responsible for his loss. Even BB-8 feels grief, but that does not stop him from reactivating a tiny droid he stumbles upon, named D-O!
